# PIP Rates 2026/27: £76.70, £114.60, £30.30, £80.00 weekly

> The four PIP weekly rates for 2026/27: Daily Living standard £76.70, enhanced £114.60; Mobility standard £30.30, enhanced £80.00. Uprated 3.8% from April 2026. Source: DWP
